meta.descricao: Seven helpers for the School: interview and public-speaking practice, help with paperwork, debate questions for the class, a lesson draft, content review and translation checking.

comum.ficaNoAparelho: Stays on your device: nothing leaves it
comum.naoEscreva: Do not write names, ID numbers, phone numbers, addresses or other people's data.
comum.conversasGuardadas: See the conversations saved on this device

dadoPessoal.cpf: There seems to be a CPF (Brazilian ID number) in the text. Remove the number to be able to send.
dadoPessoal.cartao: There seems to be a card number in the text. Remove the number to be able to send.
dadoPessoal.email: There seems to be an e-mail address in the text. If it is not needed, remove it before sending.
dadoPessoal.telefone: There seems to be a phone number in the text. If it is not needed, remove it before sending.

hub.lead: Helpers to practice an interview, rehearse a speech, understand paperwork, start a class debate, and prepare or check a lesson. They help you think: you decide.
hub.servidor: Uses the assistant: the screen says what is sent before the button.
hub.aparelho: All on your device, no server.
hub.linkDoAcompanhante: Agents for interviews, speaking, paperwork, class and team

entrevista.texto: Five interview questions for the job you choose, one at a time, with kind feedback and no grade.

oratoria.texto: Speak or write your speech, time it and see the pace measured on your device, with a comment on clarity and structure.

papelada.texto: Show a blank form, as a photo with parts covered or as text, and get each field explained in plain language. Nothing is filled in.

turma.texto: From one lesson you get 4 to 6 open questions for the class debate.

educador.texto: A lesson draft in the 6-part model, for you to check, complete and only then propose.

revisao.texto: Checks the links, sources and lesson-model parts of a text, without sending anything.

traducao.texto: You translate; the device checks that the translation kept the numbers, addresses, paragraphs and names.

entrevista.lead: The assistant asks 5 questions for the job you choose, one at a time, and comments kindly on each answer. It gives no grade.
entrevista.vaga: Job you want to practice for
entrevista.vagaDica: Write only the job title (up to 120 characters), not a company name.
entrevista.semTrabalho: You have not told us your job on this device yet. Write the job or use an example.
entrevista.respostaDica: Answer as in a real interview (up to 1,500 characters).
entrevista.concluidoTexto: You answered all 5 questions. This practice does not evaluate anyone: it is for hearing the question and thinking about how to answer.

oratoria.lead: Speak into the microphone or write the text of your speech, time it and see the pace measured here on your device. The assistant comments on clarity and structure, with no grade.
oratoria.falaDica: At least 50 characters. You can edit the transcription before sending.
oratoria.segundosDica: The stopwatch fills this field when stopped. You can also type it. Up to 300 seconds.
oratoria.semPermissao: The browser did not allow the microphone. Allow it in the site settings or write the text.
oratoria.naoOuviu: Could not hear. Try again, closer to the microphone.
oratoria.erroVoz: Voice recognition did not work just now. Write the text of your speech.
oratoria.avisoDaVoz: The transcription may get words wrong, and the audio may go to the browser's company (Google or Apple). The Institute does not record your voice: only the text shown in the field can be sent, and only when you press the button.
oratoria.semRitmo: With less than 10 seconds the pace cannot be measured.
oratoria.semFaixa: There is no right pace for everyone: compare with your previous practice.

comparacao.mais: {n} words per minute more than in the previous practice.
comparacao.menos: {n} words per minute fewer than in the previous practice.
comparacao.igual: Same pace as the previous practice.
comparacao.primeiro: This is the first saved practice: the next one can be compared with it.

oratoria.confirmar: Delete all practices on this device? This cannot be undone.
oratoria.nenhum: No practice saved on this device.
oratoria.soNumeros: Only the numbers stay on this device (up to 10 practices, for 30 days). The text and the voice are not saved here.
oratoria.modoSeguro: Safe mode is on: the practice numbers are not saved.

papelada.lead: Show a blank form, as a photo or as text. The helper lists each field and explains what it is and where you usually find the information. It fills in nothing.
papelada.aviso: Send only the blank form. Do not send anyone's data, including children's.
papelada.entendi: I read the notice: the form is blank
papelada.escolher: Choose the photo of the form
papelada.preparando: Preparing the photo on your device…
papelada.textoDica: Paste only the questions and field names (at least 10 characters), without the answers.
papelada.semTarja: You did not cover anything. If the photo has no personal data, you can send it as it is.
papelada.naoJuridica: This is not legal advice. For your own case, look for the Public Defender's Office, Procon or Meu INSS, depending on the subject.

turma.lead: For whoever facilitates a class: choose a lesson and get 4 to 6 open questions for the debate, based on the lesson summary.
turma.buscarDica: Write the subject or the name of the lesson.
turma.nada: No lesson found. Try other words.
turma.semIndice: Could not open the list of lessons now. Try again later.
turma.resumo: Lesson summary (copied from the site index)
turma.resumoDica: Read it and edit it if you want. Up to 1,200 characters. Only this and the title go to the assistant.
turma.aviso: Questions made by a machine, under review: read them before taking them to the class. Do not write classmates' names.
turma.semServidor: Without the assistant, the culture circle already brings 5 guiding questions for the class.

educador.lead: Write the topic and get a lesson draft with the 6 parts of the site's model: objective, explanation, example, exercise, summary and sources.
educador.temaDica: From 10 to 600 characters. E.g.: how to work out a discount on a purchase.
educador.moldura: Machine draft: check every fact and add the sources before any use. Nothing here is published.
educador.naoEscreva: Write only the topic. Do not include students' names or personal data.

revisao.lead: Paste the text of a lesson or a draft. The device checks the links, sources and lesson-model parts. Nothing is sent.
revisao.textoDica: You can paste the lesson text, with or without the header. Up to 20,000 characters.
revisao.naEscola: This text will appear in the School (also checks the words the School never uses)
revisao.doEducador: The educator agent's draft was placed here.
revisao.nenhum: No problem found by the rules. This does not replace a reviewer's reading.
revisao.dadoPessoal: There is personal data in the text ({tipos}). Remove it before saving or publishing.
revisao.links: To check whether the addresses still open, the coordination runs npm run conferir:links. This screen does not open any link.

regras.http: Address without https: switch to https if the site accepts it.
regras.encurtador: Shortened address: use the full address so people see where it goes.
regras.rastreio: The address carries a tracking code (utm, fbclid or gclid): remove that part.
regras.repetido: This address already appeared earlier in the text.
regras.texto-vazio: The link has no text: say where it leads.
regras.clique-aqui: The link text does not say where it leads (like “click here”): describe the destination.
regras.marcador: The “[acrescente as fontes]” marker is still in the text.
regras.sem-ano-nem-endereco: Source with no year and no address: add one of the two.
regras.numero-sem-fonte: There is a number or percentage and no source to check it.
regras.modelo-objetivo: The Objective part of the lesson model is missing.
regras.modelo-explicacao: The explanation is too short for the lesson model (under 250 words).
regras.modelo-exemplo: The Worked example part of the lesson model is missing.
regras.modelo-exercicio: The exercises of the lesson model are missing (at least 3, with the “(certa)” mark).
regras.modelo-resumo: The Summary part of the lesson model is missing.
regras.naoUniversidade: The word “university” (or its equivalent) cannot appear in the School. If it is a negation, check the context.
regras.naoDiploma: The word “diploma” (or its equivalent) cannot appear in the School. If it is a negation, check the context.

traducao.lead: This tool does not translate: it helps the translator not to lose a number, an address or a paragraph.
traducao.termos: Terms that are not translated (separated by commas)
traducao.termosDica: Already included: Instituto Lúcia, Escola Revolucionária Lúcia Maria and Gaveta Aberta.
traducao.naEscola: This text will appear in the School (also checks the words the School never uses)
traducao.tudoCerto: Nothing to check by the rules. This does not replace a reading by a speaker of the language.
traducao.revisou: A speaker of the language reviewed this translation
traducao.revisouDica: The copy with the “under review” mark is only released after you tick this box by hand.

regras.itens: The number of list items changed ({detalhe}).
regras.numero: The number {detalhe} from the original is not in the translation.
regras.numero-a-mais: The number {detalhe} is in the translation and not in the original.
regras.endereco: The address {detalhe} from the original is not in the translation.
regras.endereco-a-mais: The address {detalhe} is in the translation and not in the original.
regras.termo: The term “{detalhe}” must stay as in the original.
regras.tamanho: The translation is {detalhe} of the size of the original: check that no text is missing or extra.
regras.naoUniversidade: The word “{detalhe}” cannot appear in the School. If it is a negation, check the context.
regras.naoDiploma: The word “{detalhe}” cannot appear in the School. If it is a negation, check the context.
